title: Aagos ang Kundiman: 100 Years of the UP College of Music
summary: This event marks the start of a yearlong partnership between the UP College of Music and the Pasig local government

blocks.text: This event marks the start of a yearlong partnership between the UP College of Music and the Pasig local government
(This is a press release from the UP College of Music and the UP Office of the President.)

The UP College of Music presents a special commemorative concert on Tuesday, November 24 6:30 pm at the UP Theater Lobby in cooperation with the UP Office of the President and the Pasig Chamber of Commerce and Industry through Deep Echoes International.

blocks.caption: Aagos ang Kundiman: 100 Years of the UP College of Music

blocks.text: Titled Aagos ang Kundiman, this commemorative concert honors the centennial of Nicanor Abelardo’s iconic kundiman-kumintang “Mutya ng Pasig“ (composed in 1926, lyrics by Deogracias del Rosario) as it simultaneously celebrates the 110th anniversary of the UP College of Music (founded in 1916), where Abelardo studied and later taught.

The project frames the Pasig River not merely as a geographic landmark, but as an important lifeline and artery of economic activity, and as a living muse that shaped the romantic, nationalistic, and sonic landscape of traditional Philippine art music.

blocks.caption: Aagos ang Kundiman: 100 Years of the UP College of Music

blocks.text: As the Pasig River flows relentlessly from Laguna de Bay to Manila, through time and history, bisecting the city and changing form through the seasons, so does the kundiman. Revival, reinvention, and care are crucial collective acts to ensure that our intangible and physical heritages are nurtured and live on in creative and robust ways.

items: UP College of Music Voice students: Vyktoria Baile, Filianne Villaflor, Carmelite Salvador, Kzee Delos Santos, Ivanna Cruz, Marcus Mallonga, Jhon Michael Mauricio, Mark Nicholson Jaluag, Krisleen Andya Bareng, Jedidiah Retuta, Arianna Rodavia, Althea Domngal, Samuel Silvestre, and Lorenzo Esguerra
Faculty guitarists Nathan Manimtim, and staff guitarists RJ Balledos and Mon Nerval
Voice Faculty Stefanie Quintin and Raymond Leslie Diaz
Asian Music faculty Mlou Matute and UP TUGMA, and more.

blocks.text: Special guest is Joey Ayala. Artistic direction is by Joey Vargas.
Free and open to the public, this event marks the start of a yearlong partnership with the Pasig local government, with plans for more concerts and cultural activities in 2027. – Rappler.com
